column2: PUBLIC  UTILITIES  COMMISSION  OF  SRI LANKA
THE Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka was established under the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka Act,

column1: No.  35  of  2002.  In  accordance  with  the  requirements  stipulated  under  Sections  33(2)  and  33(3)  of  the  said  Act,  the
Commission is required to publish the estimated expenditure for the following year in the Government Gazette. Accordingly,
the Commission approved budget for 2026 is forwarded herewith.
